contrastRatios.note: Flat keys are the worst (minimum) of the two modes; byMode carries every measured pair.

email.headerNotes: White #FFFFFF header on a 3px cherry #E5121D top keyline; colaberry-horizontal.png at 150px wide, left-aligned, 24px padding. Table-based, all styles inline; logo must be an absolute https URL in production.
email.footerNotes: Near-black #1A1A1A footer; white horizontal logo 120px; legal line "Colaberry School of Data and AI is operated by Colaberry Inc." + mailing address + unsubscribe, set in #B4B4B4 12px (4.5:1+ on #1A1A1A).

families: Quicksand — SIL OFL-1.1 (logotype only, never UI)
fonts.licenseCost: None. All open-license, self-hosted in assets/fonts/ — no typeface budget needed for this brand.

notes: accent is red-600 #E5121D (button-safe), NOT raw brand cherry #FB2832 — cherry is 3.9:1 with white and is reserved for the logo, large display text and decorative accents.

accent stays constant across modes (brand rule: the cherry never changes; it clears 3:1 on both bg values). Brand-colored TEXT in dark mode lightens to #FE8A90 (red-300) for 4.5:1 — use fg-side tokens for red text, never the accent.
bgElevated intentionally equals bg in light mode — light-mode elevation comes from line + shadow (see typography.shadow); dark mode separates 0F0F0F / 1A1A1A.
success/warning/danger are text-grade tones (>=4.5:1 on bg in each mode). The full token set also ships chip pairs (status-*-bg / status-*-fg) if the platform renders tinted badges.
Focus ring: 3px berry-blue #367895 at 80% (light) / #6F9DB6 at 50% (dark) — kept separate from accent by design so focus is never lost on red controls.
